scope: release, docker, playwright, and staging smoke operations evidence

playwright_smoke.ci_gate: open until installed GitHub Actions workflow runs this smoke on PR/main

docker_build_smoke.ci_gate: open until installed GitHub Actions workflow builds SHA-tagged images on PR/main

staging_smoke.runtime_status: requires real staging URLs plus release SHA, release notes, image refs, migration/config/observability/backup/load/rollback/security evidence, and seeded smoke records; generated reports are gate-scoped with release_gate_check_id=staging_observability_backup_load and preserve no-go status until runtime smoke passes
staging_smoke.private_beta_gate: open until staging smoke passes with production-like dependencies

observability_smoke.runtime_status: local backend request-id, structured JSON access log, panic request-id, and metrics endpoint contracts are validated; staging logs/metrics/traces/dashboard import/alert evaluation remain open
observability_smoke.private_beta_gate: open until production-like observability evidence exists

staging_observability_backup_load_smoke.runtime_status: validates the private beta staging_observability_backup_load evidence bundle shape for observability, backup/restore, load, and post-deploy smoke artifacts; latest preflight verifies staging observability and remains blocked on missing backup/restore, load, and post-deploy smoke evidence
staging_observability_backup_load_smoke.private_beta_gate: open until real staging evidence for request-id/logs/traces/metrics/dashboard/alerts, Postgres/object restore, all required load modes, and post-deploy smoke is attached and release gate fixture blockers are cleared

security_scan_smoke.runtime_status: local dependency/image/secret scan wrapper; release blocking thresholds remain open
security_scan_smoke.private_beta_gate: open until dependency, image, and secret scans run in CI/staging release context

no_go_release_notes_renderer.runtime_status: renders current no-go release notes from gate fixtures and local ops drill summary
no_go_release_notes_renderer.gate_policy: checked-in no-go notes must match generated output and must not claim staging, private beta, or production completion

post_deploy_smoke_contract.entry_requirements: the generated staging smoke report must reference RELEASE_SHA, use the post_deploy profile, pass all checks, pass request-id checks, and include seeded runtime IDs for user, tenant, task, package, and export records
post_deploy_smoke_contract.output_contract: reports are written under ops/evidence/staging by default, set release_gate_check_id=staging_observability_backup_load, expose evidence_path_policy=ops/evidence/staging/, and preserve staging_observability_restore_load_missing until the full observability/backup/load preflight passes
post_deploy_smoke_contract.gate_policy: release evidence files alone are insufficient; post-deploy smoke remains unverified until scripts/staging_smoke.sh passes against staging with seeded release smoke records

local_evidence_verification.release_notes_path: must exist locally, reference RELEASE_SHA, and contain Identity, Scope, Migration List, Config Diff, Feature Flags, Smoke Plan, Evidence, Rollback Plan, Known Risks, and Go/No-Go sections
local_evidence_verification.image_refs: must include backend, web, and admin image refs tagged with RELEASE_SHA or its 12-character short SHA
local_evidence_verification.migration_evidence: must be local JSON, reference RELEASE_SHA, set environment=staging, set kind=migration, and use status passed or compatible
local_evidence_verification.config_diff_evidence: must be local JSON, reference RELEASE_SHA, set environment=staging, set kind=config_diff, and use status passed, reviewed, or no_diff
local_evidence_verification.observability_evidence: must be local JSON, reference RELEASE_SHA, set environment=staging, set kind=observability, and use status passed
local_evidence_verification.backup_restore_evidence: must be local JSON, reference RELEASE_SHA, set environment=staging, set kind=backup_restore, and use status passed
local_evidence_verification.load_evidence: must be local JSON, reference RELEASE_SHA, set environment=staging, set kind=load, use status passed, and include passed/validated evidence refs for chat_task, worker_generation, zip_export, signed_download, crawler_throttle, quota_contention, and workspace_rendering
local_evidence_verification.rollback_evidence: must be local JSON, reference RELEASE_SHA, set environment=staging, set kind=rollback, use status passed or validated, and include passed/validated evidence refs for image_rollback, feature_flag_rollback, migration_compatibility, worker_drain, and post_rollback_smoke
local_evidence_verification.security_scan_evidence: must be local JSON, reference RELEASE_SHA, set environment=staging, set kind=security_scan, use status passed, and include passed/validated evidence refs for dependency_scan, image_scan, and secret_scan

top_level_release_evidence.entry_requirements: every JSON evidence file attached to scripts/staging_smoke.sh must carry the deploy RELEASE_SHA and must set top-level environment=staging, the expected top-level kind, and an accepted top-level status; nested child entries cannot satisfy those fields for the parent artifact
top_level_release_evidence.gate_policy: release evidence with only nested staging/pass metadata remains unverified and cannot close private beta, production, or post-deploy smoke gates

observability_evidence.entry_requirements: each required entry must be passed or validated and carry a validator-visible evidence reference such as evidence_ref, trace_id, metrics_query, dashboard_uid, or alert_rule_url
observability_evidence.gate_policy: generic staging observability status is insufficient to close private beta or production observability gates

backup_restore_evidence.entry_requirements: each required drill must be passed or validated and carry a validator-visible report_path or evidence_ref
backup_restore_evidence.gate_policy: backup schedule or one restore class alone is insufficient to close private beta or production restore gates

load_evidence.entry_requirements: each load mode must be passed or validated and carry a validator-visible load_report, report_path, evidence_ref, or artifact_path
load_evidence.gate_policy: one aggregate load status or one mode alone is insufficient to close private beta or production load gates

rollback_evidence.entry_requirements: each rollback step must be passed or validated and carry a validator-visible rollback_report, smoke_report, report_path, evidence_ref, or artifact_path
rollback_evidence.gate_policy: rollback prose or image rollback alone is insufficient to close private beta or production rollback gates

security_scan_evidence.entry_requirements: each scan class must be passed or validated and carry a validator-visible scan_report, report_path, evidence_ref, or artifact_path
security_scan_evidence.gate_policy: a top-level security status without dependency, image, and secret scan reports is insufficient to close private beta or production security gates

blocking_reason_contract.local_validation: bash scripts/repo_validate.sh exercises both all-missing release evidence and complete local release evidence dry-runs; both remain no-go while runtime smoke and gate fixtures are blocked

post_deploy_smoke_go_no_go_contract.gate_policy: report decision remains no-go when smoke fails, required release evidence is absent or locally unverifiable, release-SHA-bound evidence does not reference the deploy SHA, private beta fixtures are blocked, production do-not-launch fixtures are present, or go/no-go decision inputs are incomplete
